## Creating a simple VCV-Rack plugin {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 95%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- **VCV-Rack** has a simple but powerful **plugin system**, which allows user to program their own **third-party modules**.
:::
- A plugin consists in **multiple files**, set in a specific **directory structure**.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.text code-line-numbers="1|2-3|2|3|4|4-7|5-6|7|8-9|3,7,9" filename="vcv-rack/plugins/"}
-- my_plugin/
  -- Makefile                 | Build 
  -- plugin.json              | Plugin Metadata
  -- src/
      -- plugin.cpp           | Plugin interface
      -- plugin.hpp
      -- my_plugin.cpp        | Actual plugin code
  -- res/
      -- my_plugin.svg        | Plugin appearance
```
:::

## Creating a simple VCV-Rack plugin {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 95%;"}

- **VCV-Rack** has a simple but powerful **plugin system**, which allows user to program their own **third-party modules**.
- A plugin consists in **multiple files**, set in a specific **directory structure**.
:::
- The **`plugin.json`** file contains the plugin's **metadata**: its name, author, version, etc.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.json code-line-numbers="" filename="my_plugin/plugin.json"}
{
  "slug": "emeraude", 
  "name": "Emeraude",
  "version": "2.2.0",
  "license": "MIT",
  "brand": "Emeraude",
  "author": "Pierre Cochard",
  "authorEmail": "pierre.cochard@insa-lyon.fr",
  "authorUrl": "",
  "pluginUrl": "",
  "manualUrl": "",
  "sourceUrl": "",
  "donateUrl": "",
  "changelogUrl": "",
  "modules": [
    {
      "slug": "my_module",
      "name": "My Module",
      "description": "",
      "tags": ["Oscillator"]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Creating a simple VCV-Rack plugin {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 95%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- **VCV-Rack** has a simple but powerful **plugin system**, which allows user to program their own **third-party modules**.
- A plugin consists in **multiple files**, set in a specific **directory structure**.
- The `plugin.json` file contains the plugin's **metadata**: its name, author, version, etc.
:::
- The **`plugin.hpp`** & **`plugin.cpp`** files declare the plugin instance data (nothing to do in these files for now).
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.cpp code-line-numbers="" filename="my_plugin/src/plugin.hpp"}
#pragma once
#include <rack.hpp>

using namespace rack;

// Declare the Plugin, defined in plugin.cpp
extern Plugin* pluginInstance;

// Declare each Model, defined in each module source file
extern Model* modelMyModule;

```
:::

## Creating a simple VCV-Rack plugin {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 95%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- **VCV-Rack** has a simple but powerful **plugin system**, which allows user to program their own **third-party modules**.
- A plugin consists in **multiple files**, set in a specific **directory structure**.
- The `plugin.json` file contains the plugin's **metadata**: its name, author, version, etc.
:::
- The **`plugin.hpp`** & **`plugin.cpp`** files declare the plugin instance data (nothing to do in these files for now).
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.cpp code-line-numbers="" filename="my_plugin/src/plugin.cpp"}
#include "plugin.hpp"

Plugin* pluginInstance;

void init(Plugin* p) {
	pluginInstance = p;

	// Add modules here
	p->addModel(modelMyModule);
}

```
:::

<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->
## Creating a simple VCV-Rack plugin {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 95%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- **VCV-Rack** has a simple but powerful **plugin system**, which allows user to program their own **third-party modules**.
- A plugin consists in **multiple files**, set in a specific **directory structure**.
- The `plugin.json` file contains the plugin's **metadata**: its name, author, version, etc.
- The `plugin.hpp` & `plugin.cpp` files declare the plugin instance data (nothing to do in these files for now).
:::
- Finally, **`myplugin.cpp`**, must be structured in the following way:
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.cpp code-line-numbers="4-5|6-11|12-15|16-20|21-24|26-35|37-39|42-43|44|45-46|48-49|57-74" filename="my_plugin/src/myplugin.cpp"}

#include "plugin.hpp"

// It must inherit from Module
struct MyModule : Module {
    // Declare parameter ids:
    enum ParamId {
        // Last value is equal to the number of items in the enum:
        FREQUENCY_PARAM = 0,
        PARAMS_LEN = 1
    };
    // Declare input ids:
    enum InputId {
        INPUTS_LEN
    };
    // Declare output ids:
    enum OutputId {
        MAIN_OUTPUT,
        OUTPUTS_LEN
    };
    // Declare light (LED) ids:
    enum LightId {
        LIGHTS_LEN
    };

    // Initialization function (constructor):
    MyModule() {
        config(PARAMS_LEN, INPUTS_LEN, OUTPUTS_LEN, LIGHTS_LEN);
        // Register parameters:
        // min, max, default, name, unit
        configParam(FREQUENCY_PARAM, 50.f, 100.f, 75.f, "frequency", "Hz");

        // Register outputs:
        configOutput(MAIN_OUTPUT, "main");
    }

    void process(ProcessArgs const& args) override {
        // Processing goes here:
    }
};

// The 'widget' part, meaning its graphical representation:
struct MyModuleWidget : ModuleWidget {
    MyModuleWidget(MyModule* module) {
        // Link the widget with the module:
        setModule(module);

        // Load the .svg panel in res/ directory:
        setPanel(createPanel(asset::plugin(pluginInstance, "res/my_module.svg")));

        // Create and place decorative screws:
        addChild(createWidget<ScrewSilver>(Vec(RACK_GRID_WIDTH, 0)));
        addChild(createWidget<ScrewSilver>(Vec(box.size.x - 2 * RACK_GRID_WIDTH, 0)));
        addChild(createWidget<ScrewSilver>(Vec(RACK_GRID_WIDTH, RACK_GRID_HEIGHT - RACK_GRID_WIDTH)));
        addChild(createWidget<ScrewSilver>(Vec(box.size.x - 2 * RACK_GRID_WIDTH, RACK_GRID_HEIGHT - RACK_GRID_WIDTH)));

        // Create and place frequency parameter knob:
        addParam(createParamCentered<RoundBlackKnob>(
   	        mm2px(Vec(12.899, 34.577)),
   	        module,
   	        Blinky::FREQ_PARAM
   	    ));
        // Create and place output mini-jack port:
      	addOutput(createOutputCentered<PJ301MPort>(
            mm2px(Vec(12.961, 116.674)),
            module,
            Blinky::MAIN_OUT_OUTPUT
  	    ));
        // Create and place blinky LED:
       	addChild(createLightCentered<MediumLight<GreenLight>>(
            mm2px(Vec(12.885, 54.325)),
            module,
            Blinky::LED_LIGHT
        ));
    }
};

Model* modelMyModule = createModel<MyModule, MyModuleWidget>("my_module");

```
:::
::::
